Accomplishment

2. 與同一案件英勇殉難的鄭達志醫師（Dr. John Cheng）被卡內基英雄基金會（Carnegie Heroes Fund Committee）選為2024年英雄表揚對象

Notable Accomplishments

On 5/15/2022, when a politically motivated shooting occurred at Irvine Taiwanese Presbyterian Church, he subdued the gunman in a timely manner, saving the lives of many Taiwanese American Christian congregation members present.

Together with Dr. John Cheng (鄭達志醫師), who heroically died in the same incident, was selected by the Carnegie Hero Fund Committee as a 2024 Hero honoree.
